section.37: The Book of Clothes and Adornment

37.name_native: The Book of Clothes and Adornment

hadiths.text: Suwaid b. Ghafala said:'Umar addressed us at a place known as Jabiya (Syria) and he said: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade us the wearing of silk but to the extent of two or three fingers or four fingers
